newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Cable Co plans new shares worth $53.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Cable Co plans new shares worth $53.3 mln.

text.p: The Saudi Cable Company (SCC) plans to issue new shares worth 200 million riyals ($53.3 million) in June to raise its paid-in capital to 500 million riyals, a company official said on Saturday.
The official told Reuters by telephone from Jeddah that the SCC would first offer shares worth 100 million riyals to Saudi investors, priced at 100 riyals each.
It will then issue bonus shares worth 100 million riyals to shareholders on a one-for-four basis, paid for from reserves.
The SCC has asked its shareholders to meet on June 11 to ratify the plan, he added without elaborating.
